paper_title: AttentionInfluence Adopting Attention Head Influence for Weak-to-Strong   Pretraining Data Selection
caption: The statistics of clustering. The left is the clustering result of AttentionInfluence, the right part is that of FineWeb-Edu Classifier.
model_annotation: This chart displays the clustering results of two classifiers: AttentionInfluence and FineWeb-Edu Classifier. The AttentionInfluence pie chart has a total of 10 slices, with the following categories: Policy (1, gray), Manage (2, light blue), Emerging tech (4, orange), Materials (3, red), Infor tech (5, light orange), Events & people (6, light brown), Society & culture (10, yellow), Historical review (7, dark orange), Tech & Engineer (12, dark red), and Education (25, teal). The FineWeb-Edu Classifier pie chart has 9 slices, represented by the categories: Manage (1, gray), Emerging tech (4, orange), Materials (1, red), Infor tech (3, light orange), Events & people (2, light brown), Society & culture (5, yellow), Historical review (12, dark orange), Tech & Engineer (8, dark red), and Education (38, teal). Both pie charts include percentage labels inside the slices, and the proportions do not appear visually emphasized. The slices in both pie charts appear ordered in descending size from largest to smallest.
